scripts.build:webview: vite build --config webview/manual-reader/vite.config.ts && vite build --config webview/entity-references/vite.config.ts && vite build --config webview/keyword-options/vite.config.ts && vite build --config webview/large-file-viewer/vite.config.ts
scripts.typecheck:webview: tsc --noEmit -p webview/manual-reader/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p webview/entity-references/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p webview/keyword-options/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p webview/large-file-viewer/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:webview: npm run typecheck:webview && npm run test:webview:compiled
scripts.test:webview:compiled: vitest run --config webview/manual-reader/vitest.config.ts && vitest run --config webview/entity-references/vitest.config.ts && vitest run --config webview/keyword-options/vitest.config.ts && vitest run --config webview/large-file-viewer/vitest.config.ts
scripts.typecheck:webview:debug: tsc --noEmit --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile out/debug-manual.tsbuildinfo -p webview/manual-reader/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile out/debug-references.tsbuildinfo -p webview/entity-references/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile out/debug-keywords.tsbuildinfo -p webview/keyword-options/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile out/debug-large-file.tsbuildinfo -p webview/large-file-viewer/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:compiled: npm run test:unit && npm run test:data
scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run build:webview && npm run typecheck:webview && npm run compile

webview/context.when: webviewId == lsdyna.largeFileViewer && webviewSection == largeFileRecord && largeFileCanCopy && largeFileField

editor/context.when: resourceScheme == file && (editorLangId == lsdyna || resourceExtname == .k || resourceExtname == .key || resourceExtname == .dyna)

view/item/context.when: view == lsdynaIncludeTree && viewItem == file || view == lsdynaKeywordIndex && viewItem == file
view == lsdynaIncludeTree && viewItem == file || view == lsdynaKeywordIndex && viewItem == file
